title: Prism (2 parts)
spec:
Create a cylindrical object with a rectangular section at the top by first setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop starting with an arc from (0.0, 0.0013) to (0.0004, 0.0004) and ending at (0.0013, 0.0). Continue with a line from (0.0013, 0.0) to (0.0113, 0.0), followed by another arc from (0.0113, 0.0) to (0.0121, 0.0004) and ending at (0.0125, 0.0013). Add a line from (0.0125, 0.0013) to (0.0125, 0.0113), then an arc from (0.0125, 0.0113) to (0.0121, 0.0121) and ending at (0.0113, 0.0125). Draw a line from (0.0113, 0.0125) to (0.0013, 0.0125), followed by an arc from (0.0013, 0.0125) to (0.0004, 0.0121) and ending at (0.0, 0.0113). Complete the loop with a line from (0.0, 0.0113) to (0.0, 0.0013). For the second loop, start with an arc from (0.0013, 0.0019) to (0.0014, 0.0014) and ending at (0.0019, 0.0013). Continue with a line from (0.0019, 0.0013) to (0.0106, 0.0013), followed by an arc from (0.0106, 0.0013) to (0.0111, 0.0014) and ending at (0.0113, 0.0019). Add a line from (0.0113, 0.0019) to (0.0113, 0.0106), then an arc from (0.0113, 0.0106) to (0.0111, 0.0111) and ending at (0.0106, 0.0113). Draw a line from (0.0106, 0.0113) to (0.0019, 0.0113), followed by an arc from (0.0019, 0.0113) to (0.0014, 0.0111) and ending at (0.0013, 0.0106). Complete the loop with a line from (0.0013, 0.0106) to (0.0013, 0.0019). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0125. Transform the scaled sketch into 3D using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions are 0.0125 in length, 0.0125 in width, and 0.75 in height.

For the second part, construct a prism with a slanted top surface. Begin by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to [-90.0, 0.0, -90.0] and translation vector set to [0.0063, 0.0, 0.7375]. In the first face, draw the first loop starting with a line from (0.0, 0.0125) to (0.0125, 0.0), followed by a line from (0.0125, 0.0) to (0.0125, 0.0125), and complete the loop with a line from (0.0125, 0.0125) to (0.0, 0.0125). Scale the sketch by a factor of 0.0125. Transform the scaled sketch into 3D using the specified Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0062 units in the opposite direction of the normal to cut material from the existing body. The final dimensions are 0.0125 in length, 0.0125 in width, and 0.00625 in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the base cylinder with a rectangular section at the top
base_cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0013, 0.0013)  # Start point of the first arc
    .threePointArc((0.0004, 0.0004), (0.0013, 0.0))  # First arc
    .lineTo(0.0113, 0.0)  # First line
    .threePointArc((0.0121, 0.0004), (0.0125, 0.0013))  # Second arc
    .lineTo(0.0125, 0.0113)  # Second line
    .threePointArc((0.0121, 0.0121), (0.0113, 0.0125))  # Third arc
    .lineTo(0.0013, 0.0125)  # Third line
    .threePointArc((0.0004, 0.0121), (0.0, 0.0113))  # Fourth arc
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0013)  # Fourth line
    .close()  # Close the loop
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the shape to create a cylinder
)

# Create the cutout shape (triangular prism)
cutout_shape = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0125)  # Start point of the first line
    .lineTo(0.0125, 0.0)  # First line
    .lineTo(0.0125, 0.0125)  # Second line
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0125)  # Third line
    .close()  # Close the loop
    .extrude(-0.0062)  # Extrude the shape in the opposite direction
)

# Translate and rotate the cutout shape to the correct position
cutout_shape = cutout_shape.translate((0.0063, 0.0, 0.7375)).rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), -90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)

# Perform the cut operation
r = base_cylinder.cut(cutout_shape)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the outer loop of the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0006) \
     .threePointArc((0.0002, 0.0002), (0.0006, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.0119, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.0123, 0.0002), (0.0125, 0.0006)) \
     .lineTo(0.0125, 0.0119) \
     .threePointArc((0.0123, 0.0123), (0.0119, 0.0125)) \
     .lineTo(0.0006, 0.0125) \
     .threePointArc((0.0002, 0.0123), (0.0, 0.0119)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0006) \
     .close()

# Define the inner loop of the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.001, 0.001) \
     .lineTo(0.0115, 0.001) \
     .lineTo(0.0115, 0.0115) \
     .lineTo(0.001, 0.0115) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.0125, 0.0125, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# Create the inner rectangle
inner_rectangle = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.0112, 0.0112, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False)).translate((0.0006, 0.0006, 0))

# Cut the inner rectangle from the outer rectangle
r = r.cut(inner_rectangle)
